title: Extended Combat
description: A mod that adds many new combat features/items, as well as some building blocks.
body:
Combat overhaul mod that add many Combat related features, as well as some Enchantments, Building blocks and QOL features.

### Enchantments:

_Dash_ - Allows for a dash action to be performed midair

_Air Jump_ - Allows for jumping more times midair

_Blink_ - Gives the player total invisibility for a short time, useful for quick escapes

_Obscurity_ - Hides your nametag and prevents you from angering endermen by looking at them

_Stealth_ - Hides your sprinting particles and makes some enchantments quieter to use

_Concussion_ - (Greatsword exclusive enchantment) Stuns and Blinds target for a short time, duration scales with enchantment level

_Fluid Walker_ - Allows the player to walk on fluids such as water, lava, and powdered snow, with a small speed boost that scales with enchantment level

_Swiftness_ - increases agility in midair

_Warden Sight_ - Blinds the User, but allows them to percieve every loaded entity around themselves

_Watergel_ - allows for use of riptide outside water, with limited uses

_Wavedash_ - A supplemental enchantment for dash that allows you to chain dashes in quick succession, does nothing on its own

_Backpedal_ - Like Dash, but allows the user to dash in their movement direction, limited to horizontal movement

### Changes:

_Enchantments_ - All Vanilla Enchantments have been removed from the enchanting table and Random loot

_Equipment_ - Equipment Can Only Have One Enchantment maximum

_Mace_ - Maces have been limited to +25 Bonus Damage from Smash Attacks and Smash Attacks are on a 3 minute cooldown, Enchantments such as Wind Burst and Breach still apply during the cooldown

### Weapons:

_Greatsword_ - Large Two-Handed sword that does more damage than a regular sword, albeit with a greatly slowed attack speed, capable of disabling shields

_Halberds_ - Faster to attack than Greatswords, and with a greater reach, at the cost of attack damage, functions as an axe

### QOL Features:

* 2X2 bread crafting recipe
* 2X2 paper crafting recipe
* cobweb crafting recipe
* Iron to Diamond smithing upgrade recipe
* Rotten flesh to leather smelting recipe
* Wool to string recipe
* Armour Stand arms


### Extras:

_Milk Bottles_ - 3 Types, (Plain, Chocolate, Sweet Berry) which remove effects of different types 
* _Plain_ - Removes Neutral Effects (Glowing, Bad Omen, etc...)
* _Chocolate_ - Removes Beneficial Effects (Saturation, Dolphins Grace, etc...)
* _Sweet Berry_ - Removes Harmful Effects (Levitation, Hunger, etc...)

_Hammers_ - Like pickaxes, but mine in a 3X3 area (Disabled when crouching)

_Cloaks_ - Optional cosmetic upgrade for armours of Netherite tier and above

_Echo Steel Reinforced Elytra_ - upgraded elytra with more durability

_Sleeves_ - Items in the "extendedcombat:sleeves" tag will be rendered on player's arms when worn in the left or right sleeve curios slot (textures for sleeves must be placed under "assets/**modid**/textures/models/armor/**item_name**_overlay.png")

_Food Items_ - 
* _Black Apple_ - Gives regeneration for a short time
* _Black Apple Seed_ - Found in Nether Fortress Bridge Chests, Can be planted to grow black apples, gives Wither when eaten
* _Golden Steak_ - Like a Golden Apple, but made with Cooked Beef, gives more Hunger and Saturation, along with longer Effect duration, Found in Mineshaft chests
* _Honey Bread_ - Gives Saturation Effect for 1 second, slightly better than Suspicious Stew


_Full Set Buffs_ - Wearing a full set of Echo steel will grant the wearer permanent fire resistance


### Planned Features/Changes:

* Throwing Knives
* API features moved to separate library
* Separate mod for create integration (backtanks, diving gear, and recipes)

### Known Issues:

* ~~First Person Sleeve Overlay Doesnt Render When Using Punchy~~--Unable To Fix
* HUD Elements are sometimes duplicated when using Quark Elytra indicator

**Credits**:

Nether steel Greatsword, Echo steel Greatsword, and Hammer textures were made by my friend Jasmine
